about: Readings that rest on press reports and still need checking at the primary source. Work through at most two per morning; remove an item once done.

items.task: Find the Osaka Prefecture document (reported as dated 9 Oct 2026) on grid capacity along the Osaka Bay coast and the time needed to expand it. If regional connection times are no longer well below Tokyo's, this could change the status: treat as group A. The paper is among the documents of the 2nd Osaka Digital Infrastructure Council meeting of 9 Oct 2026, listed at https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/o060020/senryaku_kikaku/smartcity_senryaku/kyogikai.html ; the progress report is https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/documents/128924/shiryono1.pdf . The file would not open on 20 Nov 2026; the owner asked for a retry at the next digest. Retried on 21 Nov 2026: the list page and the progress report again would not open. The paper from the first meeting (28 Apr 2026, https://www.pref.osaka.lg.jp/documents/128924/shiryo.pdf) was read: it gives Osaka-wide connection lead times of 'several years to five years or more' and no figure for the bay coast.

Find an original source (the Johor state government or Bernama) for the reported request that operators hold water-cooled expansions until mid-2027. The air-cooling statement of 10 Mar 2026 is already confirmed at Bernama and the owner kept the status at Not yet on 20 Nov 2026.

Read the text of Spain's royal decree on data centres once it is in the official gazette (approved 20 Nov 2026; the owner set C2 and D2 to Turned negative on 21 Nov 2026). Confirm the date it takes effect, which data centres the water rule covers and the unit of the 0.1 ceiling, then update C2 and D2.
Open the Korean ministry's legislative notice of 20 Nov 2026 and confirm the 50 megawatt exemption threshold.
Open the Texas grid operator's July 2026 update to the Texas Senate and confirm the queue size and whether 'approved to energise' is 3.2 gigawatts approved plus 5.9 energised.
Confirm the 16 Nov 2026 filings in the federal regulator's dockets EL26-67 to EL26-72, and whether Southwest Power Pool filed on 20 Nov.
Verify or replace the cumulative restarted nuclear capacity figure of 13,946 megawatts.
